contexts.name: gitlab-panel-shell

contexts.description: Detects pipeline status transitions from active (running/pending) to terminal (success/failed/canceled) and fires both OS-level desktop notifications and in-app notification center entries. Preferences (which terminal states trigger alerts, sound on/off) are persisted in localStorage and configurable via the PipelineNotificationPrefs component rendered on the connection tab.
contexts.name: gitlab-pipeline-notifications

contexts.description: Real-time pipeline monitor that lists recent pipelines for the selected project and shows job-level detail with expandable log output. Supports manual pipeline triggering and auto-refreshes running pipelines via visibility-aware polling. Dispatches desktop and in-app notifications on status transitions through usePipelineNotifications.
contexts.name: gitlab-pipeline-viewer

contexts.description: Composite glyph card components that assemble sigil sub-parts into user-facing cards: GlyphCard (full overview card combining sigil + legend + totems + dimension panel + model badge), GlyphGrid (multi-card grid layout), GlyphQuestionPanel (question/adoption prompt panel), DimensionPanel (expandable detail panel for one dimension), ChannelTotem (communication channel visual), ConnectorTotem (data connector visual), and ModelBadge (LLM model chip).
contexts.name: glyph-card-display

contexts.description: The command panel inside the Glyph that lets users compose and dispatch a one-shot execution with full connector/event/schedule/messaging configuration. A multi-row panel (messaging, tools, when) leads into a composer sub-system with dedicated picker modals for connectors, events, schedules, and messaging channels. Recipe suggestions are surfaced when eligibility criteria are met.
contexts.name: glyph-command-panel

contexts.description: Static glyph data definition files, one per feature area, that describe how each feature's capabilities map onto the 8 sigil dimensions. Each file exports a GlyphRow[] or similar structure consumed by GlyphCard and related components to populate the sigil for coaching, feeds, goals, KPIs, rate-limiting, relay, roadmap routes, roadmap waypoints, and scope maps.
contexts.name: glyph-definitions

contexts.description: The Glyph is the rich persona detail card surface used throughout the app (sidebar, overview, companion). It supports multiple layout modes (full, row strip, cinema, dialogue-cinema, edit face, sigil face, stage surface) and shows capability previews, activity strips, answer cards, dimension summaries, and a top bar. Layout state and compose config are managed by dedicated hooks.
contexts.name: glyph-persona-card

contexts.description: Pure-function utility modules powering the glyph system's data layer: channels.ts (parseChannels, channelIcon, channelTint — parsing persona channel configuration), cron.ts (humanizeCron — converts cron expressions to readable strings like 'Every day at 9 AM'), and triggers.ts (triggerIcon, prettyTriggerType, triggerDetail — display helpers for trigger types). No React; all imported by glyph UI components.
contexts.name: glyph-utilities

contexts.description: Models and surfaces the goal acceptance workflow — the criteria by which a goal transitions from agent-driven work to human review and sign-off. Includes the acceptance overlay, triage view, KPI linkage, status badges, and the business logic for partitioning and scoring goal acceptance state.
contexts.name: goal-acceptance

contexts.description: Main goal-tracking surface for teams and projects. Renders goals as a kanban board, timeline, constellation map, and mission list. Supports creating and editing goals via a modal, detailed drawers, task tables, and a handoff panel for agent-to-human hand-offs. Scope can be all-projects or per-project, with the Done lane toggleable.
contexts.name: goal-board

contexts.description: The persistent left-rail coach-mark panel that guides users through multi-step spotlight tours across the live app. GuidedTour.tsx is the state machine driver: it reads the active tour from tourSlice, calls navigateToStep to route the app and fire step-specific side effects (appearance baseline capture, modal open, Obsidian probe), manages minimize/resume/completion screens, and enforces the onboarding-modal precedence contract. TourLauncher is the topbar entry point.
contexts.name: guided-tour-engine

contexts.description: Smoke specs for the onboarding guided-tour system: tours-explore verifies every tour in the registry can be started and its first step asserts the expected testid; tours-obsidian-brain walks the obsidian-brain tour including the real vault-connect step against the filesystem.
contexts.name: guided-tour-smoke

contexts.description: Spawns headless Claude Code CLI sessions for each area and parses their structured results. Assembles a detailed prompt from project context, accumulated learnings, recent progress, area spec, and a required result block, then runs `claude -p ... --output-format stream-json` as a child process. Also manages the AGENTS.md learnings file that accumulates cross-session knowledge.
contexts.name: harness-executor

contexts.description: Builds a reproducible step-by-step playbook (HarnessGuide) from completed harness iterations and persists it as both JSON and rendered Markdown. Each completed area contributes a GuideStep with actions, files changed, decisions extracted from assistant output, gotchas, and verification results. The guide accumulates cross-area learnings and is updated incrementally so partial runs still produce a useful artifact.
contexts.name: harness-guide-generator

contexts.description: Implements the core Plan→Execute→Verify→Record→Iterate loop that drives autonomous codebase quality improvement. Loads or initialises a persisted plan and guide, selects the next unblocked area, delegates to the executor, runs required verification gates, updates feature statuses and progress, and emits typed events to listeners. Supports pause/resume and a final optional-gate pass after the loop completes.
contexts.name: harness-orchestrator

contexts.description: Converts a ScenarioDefinition into a persisted HarnessPlan with topologically-sorted ModuleAreas that respect dependency declarations. Provides area selection that returns the first pending area whose dependencies are all completed, plus a stats updater that recalculates the passing-feature count after each iteration.
contexts.name: harness-plan-builder

contexts.description: Provides the Personas-specific quality scenario (35 areas across typography migration, i18n coverage, and background-process notifications) and the CLI entry point that wires everything together. The scenario parser encodes the three-goal plan with full dependency graph; the CLI runner parses argv, builds HarnessConfig, attaches a console event logger, handles graceful SIGINT pause, and prints the final guide path.
contexts.name: harness-scenario-runner

contexts.description: Defines the complete type system for the autonomous harness loop and exports the public library surface. Contains every interface (HarnessPlan, ModuleArea, ExecutorResult, VerificationReport, HarnessGuide, ScenarioDefinition, etc.) and the barrel re-exports that make the harness consumable as a module. This is the single source of truth for all data shapes flowing between orchestrator, executor, verifier, plan-builder, and guide-generator.
contexts.name: harness-types-api

contexts.api_surface: verify(), runGate(), PERSONAS_GATES, typographyAuditGate(), i18nAuditGate(), notificationCoverageGate()
contexts.description: Runs quality gates synchronously after each area execution to gate progress. Ships built-in gates for TypeScript typecheck, ESLint lint, and Vite production build, plus factory functions for Personas-specific custom gates (typography raw-class audit, i18n hardcoded-string audit, notification coverage count). Required gates block area completion; non-required gates are deferred to a single final pass.
contexts.name: harness-verifier

contexts.description: Builds the Fleet session prompt for a scoped practice-harvest run. The prompt encodes the ground-truth contract (snapshot.json, closed topic taxonomy, closed ftype vocabulary, output JSON shape) that aligns with the Rust ingest deserializer. Exports harvestDispatchKey so extraction and auto-ingest name sessions consistently.
contexts.name: harvest-dispatch-prompt

contexts.description: Pure logic for selecting which harvest scopes to dispatch next. Filters out already-running sessions, slices the next wave of size HARVEST_WAVE (4) from the backend-ordered coverage list, and reports how many remain. Also computes a file-weighted coverage ratio (done/total scopes + mean read depth percentage) for display in the extraction menu.
contexts.name: harvest-wave-logic

contexts.description: Repository for the self-healing engine — stores detected execution issues, healing action records, circuit breaker states, and scheduled retry jobs. When a persona execution fails in a recognized pattern, the healing engine proposes and attempts automated recovery actions tracked in these tables.
contexts.name: healing-repo

contexts.description: The Learning tab: a guided-tours timeline showing all registered product tours with completion state, a tour detail modal that previews steps and lets the user launch or resume a tour, and a static illustration library for learning card visuals. Integrates with the TOUR_REGISTRY and tourSlice for completion tracking.
contexts.name: home-learning-hub

contexts.description: Top-level tab orchestration for the Home page. Renders four lazily-loaded panels (Welcome, Cockpit, Roadmap, Learning) inside a keep-alive pane pattern that hides rather than unmounts inactive tabs to avoid re-fetching on tab switches. Also provides utility hooks for pausable polling intervals and prefetch scheduling for non-active tabs.
contexts.name: home-page-shell

contexts.description: The Power Moves quest board on the Learning tab: a curated registry of 12 advanced product capabilities grouped by outcome (save time, prevent failures, level up, orchestrate), each with a 'Try it' action that navigates to the relevant section and spotlights the feature. Includes honest-completion probes (IPC calls that detect real usage), persistent tried/completed state via a Zustand store, and a flash-spotlight animation after landing.
contexts.name: home-power-moves

contexts.api_surface: useLiveRoadmap (external HTTP fetch for live roadmap data)
contexts.description: The 'What's New' / Roadmap tab: displays the live roadmap fetched from a remote endpoint (NOW/NEXT/LATER lanes with a hero in-progress item), falls back to bundled static roadmap items, and shows shipped release cards below. Includes a freshness pill with manual refresh, an i18n adapter that reshapes flat t.releases.* keys into the shape the view consumes, and a lazy-loaded empty-lane traced SVG glyph.
contexts.name: home-roadmap-releases

contexts.description: Business logic backing the Welcome surface: fleet health scoring, 'Since You Left' briefing (diffs activity since last session), navigation-card status chip derivation, vault credential availability check, and session resume context (last active persona/section). These hooks drive the status badges and briefing panel shown on the Welcome tab.
contexts.name: home-welcome-logic

contexts.description: The main Welcome tab UI: a hero header with time-of-day greeting, a quick-navigation card grid linking to all major app sections, a language switcher card grid, and a get-started onboarding prompt. Composes visual layout blocks and reads nav-card status from a shared hook to show health chips per section card.
contexts.name: home-welcome-surface

contexts.description: Remote HTTP inference path that runs a persona against an OpenAI-compatible LLM provider (DashScope/Qwen) instead of the local Claude CLI. Handles streaming text, tool-calling loop, API-key storage in the OS keyring, and Tauri event emission matching the CLI path's contract. Enables BYOM (bring your own model) workflows for latency or cost trade-offs.
contexts.name: http-inference-engine

contexts.description: Utility for rendering i18n-debt strings — English text that has not yet been migrated to the i18n system. `DebtText` is a React component that reads from the `debt` section of the translation bundle via key, and `debtText()` is the non-hook equivalent for non-React callers. Allows incremental i18n migration without hardcoding English directly in JSX.
contexts.name: i18n-debt-text

contexts.description: Manages the English base translation bundle through a lazy-parse cache. `englishSections.ts` stores all sections as raw JSON strings (generated into `enSectionStrings.ts`) and parses each section on first access, eliminating the 500KB+ cold-parse cost. `en.ts` is a backward-compat Proxy shim so legacy imports of `{ en, type Translations }` continue to compile without per-file updates.
contexts.name: i18n-english-sections

contexts.description: Bridges raw Rust error strings to translated user-friendly messages with actionable suggestions. `useTranslatedError.ts` matches raw IPC error strings against a priority-ordered `ERROR_KEY_MAP` of patterns, resolves translated `message`/`suggestion` pairs from the `error_registry` i18n section, chains into the non-translated `resolveError()` as a fallback, and records Sentry breadcrumbs with the pre-rewrite raw string for operator diagnostics.
contexts.name: i18n-error-resolution

contexts.description: Single source of truth for the set of supported locales the app ships. Defines the `LOCALES` array with BCP 47 codes, native names, English names, and writing direction (ltr/rtl). Provides `LocaleCode` union type, `isLocaleCode` guard, and `getLocaleDescriptor` lookup. To add or remove a language, edit this file and add/remove the matching `locales/<code>.json`.
contexts.name: i18n-locale-registry

contexts.description: Dev-only pseudo-locale that wraps every translated string in `⟦⟧` brackets and replaces ASCII letters with accented look-alikes, making hardcoded English strings immediately visible on screen as unaccented text. Activated via `?pseudo=1` URL param (persists to localStorage) or a `window.__togglePseudoLocale__()` console toggle. The transformed bundle is synthesized at runtime from the English bundle with no JSON file to maintain.
contexts.name: i18n-pseudo-locale

contexts.description: Declares which translation sections each sidebar route needs and provides the `useActiveI18nSections` hook for route-aware section preloading. `routeSections.ts` maps each `SidebarSection` to its required sections and merges with always-loaded `BASE_SECTIONS`. `useSidebarTranslation.ts` provides an optimized cached lookup of sidebar item IDs to translated labels, avoiding per-render Map rebuilds.
contexts.name: i18n-route-sections

contexts.description: Test suite and behavioral contract for the i18n system. `useTranslatedError.test.ts` pins the four-link error resolution fallback chain (translated → raw fallback → English friendly → generic). `chainStopReasons.parity.test.ts` enforces parity between the Rust backend's `stop_reason` string constants and the i18n `status_tokens.chain_stop` keys, catching untranslated tokens at build time. `CONTRACT.md` documents the four-layer translation contract (Rust codes → IPC → React → translators).
contexts.name: i18n-tests-and-contract

contexts.description: Resolves Rust backend machine tokens (e.g. `"queued"`, `"critical"`) to translated user-visible labels. The backend sends language-agnostic identifiers over IPC that must never be shown raw to users; `tokenLabel()` maps them through the `status_tokens.*` i18n sections. Covers execution, event, automation, severity, priority, healing, connector, test, and dev token categories.
contexts.name: i18n-token-resolution

contexts.description: Core React hook and lazy-loading runtime for the i18n system. Implements per-section async loading via Vite's import.meta.glob, a pub/sub store sync pattern, deep-merge fallback from English to non-English sections, and the `interpolate`/`tx` helper for variable substitution. Also exposes `getActiveTranslations()` for non-React callers and `preloadSections` for intent-based prefetching.
contexts.name: i18n-translation-hook

contexts.description: Codegen'd TypeScript type tree for the full translation bundle. Generated from `src/i18n/locales/en.json` by `scripts/i18n/gen-types.mjs` on `predev`/`prebuild`. Provides `t.section.key` autocomplete throughout the codebase and catches key-drift at compile time. Must be regenerated and committed whenever `en.json` changes.
contexts.name: i18n-type-system

contexts.description: Repositories for user identity management, OAuth token lifecycle tracking, and OAuth metrics. Stores identity provider bindings, token refresh history, and per-provider token usage metrics that feed into credential health monitoring.
contexts.name: identity-oauth-repo

contexts.description: Low-level infrastructure type primitives shared across the app. tauriError.ts defines the TauriError discriminated union for typed IPC error handling; timeRange.ts provides the TimeRange type and preset constants used by observability dashboards; terminalEvents.ts defines the streaming terminal event shape emitted by the CLI execution engine.
contexts.name: infrastructure-primitive-types

contexts.description: Knowledge-base document ingestion and structured extraction pipeline. The ingest module orchestrates the read→chunk→embed→store-vectors flow as a background job with progress events and cancellation. The extract module adds a two-pass LLM extraction (schema inference + per-chunk entity extraction) with a human gate between passes, turning unstructured documents into typed, queryable rows.
contexts.name: knowledge-base-pipeline

contexts.description: Automated knowledge extraction pipeline that mines project artefacts and agent transcripts to surface reusable practices into the workspace library. harvestWave executes a multi-wave harvest with dedup; libraryModel and libraryPulse derive health metrics for the knowledge library; useHarvestAutoIngest subscribes to events and auto-ingests new entries; KnowledgeLibrary and KnowledgeTree render the library view; ExtractionMenu triggers on-demand extraction.
contexts.name: knowledge-harvest

contexts.description: The main container for the workspace knowledge library. Orchestrates derivation of view-model items from raw rows, manages the review queue (a snapshot of IDs taken at open time), and wires together the KnowledgeTree table, WorkspacePulse dashboard, and all modals (detail, rollout, create). Also exposes bulk-decide and project-to-repos projection actions.
contexts.name: knowledge-library-host

contexts.description: The paginated, filterable, sortable DataGrid view of workspace knowledge items, backed by a topic-taxonomy rail. Computes rail metadata (share bars and pending counts) from the full corpus, supports bulk selection of undecided items, and exposes per-column filter dropdowns for status bucket, kind, and origin project.
contexts.name: knowledge-tree-table

contexts.description: KPI measurement, connector binding, and goal-derivation pipeline. The evaluator runs active KPIs by their stored procedure (codebase command or connector API call) and records rolling measurements. The binding module wires a connector KPI to a semantic metric type via a curated recipe or LLM-composed procedure that is test-run before saving. The derivation module closes the steering loop: an off-track KPI fires a headless Claude decision that creates a team goal, which the goal-advance module converts into a running team assignment.
contexts.name: kpi-and-goals

contexts.description: KPI proposal scanning and simulation — a headless Claude pass that analyses the context map, existing KPIs, and the codebase to propose measurable KPIs for each project context; a KPI composition module for assembling multi-signal composite metrics; a KPI simulator for projecting future values; and the live roadmap command (milestone convergence view for the ship tab).
contexts.name: kpi-intelligence

contexts.description: Pure business-logic layer for KPI calculations: distance to target, convergence scoring, measurement provenance tracking, sim prompt generation, and descriptive measurement labels. These are domain-model utilities with no UI dependencies, consumed by both the KPI tracking surface and the Factory overview.
contexts.name: kpi-math-models

contexts.description: Full KPI management surface including the KPI dashboard, connect wizard, proposal queue, signal board, steering panel, sim control, and detail modal. Users connect data sources to KPIs, review AI-generated proposals, simulate projections, and steer via autopilot controls. Depends on kpi-math-models for calculations.
contexts.name: kpi-tracking

contexts.description: Repositories for A/B testing experiments on persona configurations — stores experiment definitions, assignment buckets, and outcome measurements for comparing different persona prompt variations. Enables data-driven optimization of persona performance through controlled experiments.
contexts.name: lab-ab-testing-repo

contexts.description: Lab Arena for head-to-head persona battles: an arena panel that runs two personas against the same prompt (ArenaPanelColosseum) and shows side-by-side results with a winner decision. ArenaHistory tracks past matches. Also includes the Lab use-case execution panel for running labelled use-case scenarios in mock or real mode.
contexts.name: lab-arena

contexts.description: Repositories for persona evaluation runs and consensus scoring — stores structured evaluation results comparing persona outputs against benchmarks, consensus mechanisms for aggregating multiple evaluator scores, and arena head-to-head matchup records.
contexts.name: lab-eval-repo

contexts.description: Domain types for the Agent Lab evaluation system: `LabRun` and `LabRunStatus` state machine for tracking evaluation runs, `TestRun` and `TestSuite` for structured test execution records, `OutputAssertion` for defining and validating expected agent outputs, and `SlaDefinition` / `SlaViolation` for service-level agreement tracking. These are the shared DB row shapes consumed by the lab repository and lab evaluation engine.
contexts.name: lab-quality-models

contexts.description: Reusable Lab UI primitives used across arena, versions table, and use-case panels: result card, result modal, history table, progress strip, event stream, diff viewer, inline diff preview, quality badge, skeleton, stagger group, tab, and scenario detail panel. Also includes chart theme and utility functions shared within the Lab feature.
contexts.name: lab-shared-primitives

contexts.api_surface: Tauri commands: lab_start_arena, lab_start_ab, lab_start_matrix, lab_start_eval, list_tests, create_test_suite
contexts.description: IPC wrappers for the Agent Lab: arena (multi-model comparison runs), A/B testing, matrix runs, and eval runs — all designed to benchmark persona prompt versions against configurable models. Also covers test and test-suite CRUD for defining reusable evaluation scenarios. Powers the Lab 7-tab UI and version×model result table.
contexts.name: lab-testing-api

contexts.description: Hooks for the agent Lab and persona testing surfaces: subscribing to lab-scoped execution events, managing multi-select toggle state for test case lists, and running persona test suites with result tracking. Supports the Lab tab's A/B-style evaluation and the Governance test runner.
contexts.name: lab-testing-hooks

contexts.description: Repositories for persona version management, genome tracking (evolving prompt DNA), user ratings, and evolution history. Enables the Lab feature where users can track how a persona's prompt has evolved over time, rate versions, and roll back to previous configurations.
contexts.name: lab-versioning-repo

contexts.description: Version matrix and economics panel for the Lab tab: shows all persona versions in a table with per-version status, rating cell, row actions, and a post-activation reconcile dialog. LabEconomicsPanel aggregates cost and token metrics. Backed by evalAggregation, labAggregation, versionMatrixRows, and labFeedbackLoop libs.
contexts.name: lab-versions-eval

contexts.description: Loading skeleton placeholders for deferring render cost (ContentHeaderSkeleton, ListSkeleton, TableSkeleton, RouteChunkSkeleton — the last renders nothing for ~150 ms to avoid flash), DeferUntilIdle (defers children to requestIdleCallback to avoid blocking paint), and the two-column settings layout: SettingsScaffold (sticky scroll-spy rail + stacked SectionCard content) and its useSectionScrollSpy hook.
contexts.name: layout-skeleton-settings

contexts.description: Core page and panel layout primitives: ContentLayout (standard content area shell), ActionRow (horizontal filter/status toolbar), PanelTabBar (in-panel tab bar), SegmentedTabs (pill tab switcher), SectionCard (card with header/status-border/collapse), SectionHeader (icon+title+badge+trailing actions), SectionHeading, FullScreenOverlay, ReasoningTrace (expandable AI reasoning display), VibeThemeProvider (persona-derived CSS custom properties), KanbanBoard (generic HTML5 drag-to-move status columns), and the systemLoad pure EMA/hysteresis module.
contexts.name: layout-structure

contexts.description: The view-model and query layer for the knowledge library. Transforms raw WorkspaceKnowledge rows into KnowledgeItemView objects, computes review priority (evidence × confidence), maintains status lifecycle ordering, and exposes the shared topic-tree builder and search filter bound to the WorkspaceKnowledge type.
contexts.name: library-view-model

contexts.description: The Lifecycle module manages the dev-clone persona setup flow for a project — creating a trigger-backed clone persona that auto-runs on review events. LifecyclePage orchestrates trigger/persona creation and deletion; SetupTab and FlowSteps render the multi-step onboarding UI; useDevCloneAdoption and DevCloneAdoptionCard wrap the adopt task machinery; CompetitionPage is the entry point into prompt competitions.
contexts.name: lifecycle-setup

contexts.description: Real-time event bus monitor: streams live PersonaEvent records via the event bus listener, with pause/resume, per-frame rAF batching to prevent OOM under high throughput, rolling events/min counter, filter by status/type, and a detail modal per event. Serves as the main operational visibility surface for the event bus.
contexts.name: live-stream

contexts.api_surface: listUseCases, createUseCase, LLM connector observability endpoints
contexts.description: LLM monitoring and use-case pinpoints page that surfaces per-use-case LLM cost, latency, and error rollups over selectable time windows (24h, 7d, 30d). MonitoringSection shows infra-level signals from the assigned connector; useLlmPinpoints and useMonitoringPinpoints fetch and normalise the data. The page also surfaces a use-case creation flow.
contexts.name: llm-monitoring-pinpoints

contexts.description: Manages LLM observability connector assignments across projects via an AssignmentMatrix UI. Adapters in llmTracingAdapters normalise responses from different LLM monitoring connectors (Langfuse, Langsmith, etc.) into a unified LlmPinpoint shape consumed by the pinpoints layer. Tested by the adapter unit test.
contexts.name: llm-tracing-matrix

contexts.description: Integrations for locally-hosted AI models and web scraping capabilities. The ollama module provides a typed client for the Ollama local LLM server (compiled with the ollama feature); scraper implements web page fetching and content extraction for the research-lab plugin's source gathering (compiled with the scraper feature).
contexts.name: local-ai-integrations

contexts.description: SVG layer renderers for the three user-authored canvas artefacts: group rectangles (GroupLayer), project links/connections (LinkLayer), and free-text notes (NoteLayer). Route.tsx computes the SVG path between two island centres. tidyLayout.ts provides an automatic tidy-tree layout algorithm for repositioning islands.
contexts.name: mastermind-canvas-layers

contexts.api_surface: spawnSession (fleet IPC), listCredentials (vault IPC), runScan (devTools IPC), getAppSetting/setAppSetting (settings IPC)
contexts.description: Root entry point for the Mastermind multi-project development canvas (Teams → Development tab). Orchestrates all data families (passports, KPI, goals, fleet sessions, Sentry monitoring, LLM spend, cross-project relations) into a unified `scene`, applies per-island overrides, and routes all user interactions to the appropriate popovers, sidebars and modals. Wraps the active canvas variant inside FactoryDataProvider and ImproveProvider.
contexts.name: mastermind-canvas-page

contexts.description: Shared canvas runtime used by all Mastermind layout variants: SVG sea backdrop, imperative pan/zoom camera (60fps via requestAnimationFrame), island drag-and-drop, connect and group tools, viewport culling, and keyboard navigation between islands. Variants supply only an island renderer function; all canvas machinery lives here.
contexts.name: mastermind-canvas-shell

contexts.description: The final Mastermind canvas view: MastermindHexMosaic renders projects as interlocking honeycombs using the MosaicIsland renderer — a thin wrapper over CanvasShell supplying only the island renderer. The Inverse Grid prototype and the variant switcher were retired 2026-08.
contexts.name: mastermind-canvas-variants

contexts.description: Registry and supporting logic for the per-project dimension tiles shown on each canvas island. dimRegistry.ts is the single source of truth: each dimension declares its label, icon, category, row-key, actionability kind, and a `derive()` function that maps a readiness passport to status/detail/progress. dimCategories groups dimensions for far/mid zoom rollup; dimMeta provides display metadata; dimActions decorates tiles with clickable improve actions; ink.ts provides the colour system.
contexts.name: mastermind-dimension-system

contexts.description: Per-island UI building blocks rendered by every canvas variant: IslandBanner (header with state indicator, fleet badges, persona count), IslandMenu (context menu for terminal/dispatch actions), DimTile and DimGlyph (dimension cell + icon renderers), DimLegend (status legend overlay), StatColumns (six side-column KPI/readiness stats), and FleetBadges (docked CLI session dots).
contexts.name: mastermind-island-ui

contexts.description: Durable persistence layer for the five canvas layout artifact kinds: island positions, group rectangles, user-drawn links, free-text notes, and the hidden-project set. Stores everything as a single versioned JSON document in the app settings DB (`mastermind.layout.v1`) with a 500ms debounced write-through, one-time migration from legacy localStorage keys, and a graceful localStorage fallback for browser-only dev.
contexts.name: mastermind-layout-persistence

contexts.description: Floating overlay components that appear on dimension cell clicks and tool actions: CategoryPopover (collapsed category drill-down), DimListPopover (stack-list items like datalinks/support), GoalListPopover (ongoing dev goals), KpiListPopover (per-project KPI status list), IdeaScanPopover (scan dispatch with agent/context/target controls), PersonaListPopover (running personas with navigation), FleetListPopover (live CLI sessions), and the base ListPopover. Also includes LinkEditor and NoteEditor for canvas annotation tools.
contexts.name: mastermind-popovers

contexts.description: Pure view-model types and the scene derivation function for the Mastermind canvas. Converts AppPassport arrays plus cross-project metadata into a typed `Scene` (islands + edges) with no store or IPC access. Defines Island, DimNode, IslandEdge, Camera, CanvasMode, ZoomBand, and all geometric helpers (sceneBounds, zoomBand).
contexts.name: mastermind-scene-model

contexts.description: Zustand store that is the batched data spine for the Mastermind canvas. Fetches and caches cross-project relations, idea scans, Sentry monitoring summaries, dev goals, and LLM spend with ≤1 IPC per family per load, tracks per-family fetch status for honest health reporting, and supports surgical per-project scan invalidation. Also provides island stat builders and deterministic mock stats for demo mode.
contexts.name: mastermind-scene-store

contexts.description: Full-panel and persistent sidebar components: ProjectListSidebar (collapsible list of all islands with hide/show toggle), ProjectSidebar (per-project detail slide-in with passport data), MemorySection (project memory viewer inside the sidebar), FleetPreviewPanel (CLI session preview dock), DispatchFleetModal (instruction modal for spawning a background Fleet session per project or group), DemoNotice (onboarding notice for first-time users without scanned projects), and DataHealthBar (bottom banner reporting failed data families with retry).
contexts.name: mastermind-sidebars-panels

contexts.description: Unit and integration tests covering the Mastermind canvas's core logic: scene derivation (status, edges, live state, idea-scan freshness, unknown family states), sceneStore lifecycle, layoutStore persistence and migration, canvas camera interactions, tidy-tree layout algorithm, keyboard navigation, dimension action decoration, and category grouping. Includes a passportFactory test helper for constructing minimal AppPassport fixtures.
contexts.name: mastermind-tests

contexts.api_surface: authorize_tool_call() called per tools/call before dispatch
contexts.description: Capability-token authentication layer for the personas-mcp stdio surface. Validates pk_ tokens against the shared external_api_keys registry (same hashing, expiry, and revocation semantics as the HTTP management API), enforcing the personas:execute scope on every tools/call while allowing the MCP handshake methods through unauthenticated. Records per-call audit rows (200 success / 403 scope-denial) so operators can distinguish stdio activity from HTTP traffic.
contexts.name: mcp-auth-gate

contexts.description: Provisions personas-mcp into external AI client configurations (Claude Code, Cursor). Writes the server binary path, DB path, and a freshly minted pk_ capability token into the target's mcp.json env block, so the client can spawn the stdio server with an authenticated token on every invocation. The token is created in the shared external_api_keys registry at install time and never stored separately.
contexts.name: mcp-client-install

contexts.description: MCP (Model Context Protocol) gateway and tools bridge — exposes credentials and persona capabilities as MCP-compatible resources and tools, and manages the vector knowledge base used for semantic credential search. Allows external MCP clients to use Personas as a credential provider.
contexts.name: mcp-gateway

contexts.api_surface: JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio: initialize, notifications/initialized, tools/list, tools/call
contexts.description: Implements the JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP protocol dispatcher that is the entry point for the personas-mcp stdio server. Handles the MCP handshake (initialize / notifications/initialized), tools/list, and tools/call routing, delegating auth and tool execution to sibling modules. Also wraps the app's SQLite connection pool into an MCP-scoped McpDbPool so raw-SQL tool handlers and repository-layer routed handlers share a single connection source.
contexts.name: mcp-protocol-dispatcher

contexts.api_surface: list_tools() → MCP inputSchema descriptors; call_tool(name, args, pool) → MCP content response
contexts.description: Defines and dispatches all MCP tools exposed to external AI clients (Claude Code, Cursor, etc.). Covers persona CRUD and execution, knowledge base search and annotation, execution history search, template browsing, arena model comparison, sandboxed file drive access, codebase context-map queries, Google Workspace connector bridges (Gmail, Drive, Calendar), Obsidian vault read/write, and an optional local LLM delegate tool for mixed-engine runs. State-mutating tools route through shared repository layers; read-only tools issue raw SQL against McpDbPool.
contexts.name: mcp-tool-handlers

contexts.api_surface: walk_vault(), tfidf_scores(), tokenize(), snippet_for() — used by obsidian_vault_search and obsidian_vault_write_note tools
contexts.description: Self-contained Obsidian vault search library used by the MCP sidecar without Tauri or the app's full command layer. Implements recursive markdown note walking, a lowercase alphanumeric tokenizer, smoothed Robertson TF-IDF scoring with title boosting, and a snippet extractor for search result previews. Integration tests exercise the full search and write path against a real temp vault and DB, including the Athena-toggle gate.
contexts.name: mcp-vault-search

contexts.description: AI media production commands — FFmpeg-based video/audio rendering, voiceover synthesis, speech-to-text transcription, and schema-policy enforcement for media output. Supports title overlays, animated entrances, and render-plan IR compilation for the Artist media studio feature.
contexts.name: media-studio

contexts.description: Domain types for the persona memory and knowledge systems: `Memory` (structured recall entries with scope, kind, and injection metadata), `KnowledgeEntry` (execution-derived intelligence about tool sequences, failure patterns, and model performance with annotation support), and `KnowledgeBase` (ml-feature-gated vector store metadata for semantic retrieval). These back both the human-review panel and the autonomous memory injection pipeline.
contexts.name: memory-knowledge-models

contexts.description: Inter-persona message passing and test data seeding — the messages module handles direct structured messages between personas and the runtime, while mock_seed generates realistic fixture data for development and testing of the communication layer.
contexts.name: messaging

contexts.description: Repositories for in-app messaging, alert rules, and SLA tracking. Stores persona-to-user messages, system notifications, and configurable alert rules that fire when execution metrics cross thresholds. SLA tracking records response-time commitments and violation events.
contexts.name: messaging-alerts-repo

contexts.description: Modal and overlay primitives used across the app: BaseModal re-export (enforced by ESLint over fixed-inset backdrops), ConfirmDestructiveModal (typed delete/reset confirmation), FilterBar (horizontal list filter), FirstUseConsentModal (first-launch onboarding), QuickEditPopover (anchored inline-edit), UnsavedChangesModal (navigation guard), and DispatchChooser (consent surface for routing a prepared prompt to Dev Runner / Fleet / Claude CLI / Console).
contexts.name: modal-overlay-dispatch

contexts.description: Model configuration tab allowing per-persona model selection, budget controls, prompt-cache controls, provider credential binding, and an A/B model comparison panel. useEffectiveConfig resolves inherited vs. overridden configuration from the persona and global defaults. Supports LiteLLM custom configs and Ollama local model presets.
contexts.name: model-config

contexts.description: Provides per-model token pricing data (input/output cost per 1M tokens) for Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google model families. Used to compute execution cost estimates shown in the UI and in analytics dashboards. Local model families are detected and treated as zero-cost.
contexts.name: model-pricing

contexts.description: Handles model selection and routing logic — mapping persona configurations and BYOM settings to actual LLM provider endpoints. Applies fallback strategies, tier-based routing, and cost optimization rules to select the appropriate model for each execution.
contexts.name: model-routing

contexts.description: Analyses an imported n8n workflow's connector requirements against the user's vault: connectorMatching applies ranked credential-to-connector fuzzy matching, credentialGapAnalysis identifies unmet requirements, connectorHealth aggregates per-connector readiness, and protocolParser extracts structured connector metadata from raw n8n protocol strings.
contexts.name: n8n-connector-analysis

contexts.description: n8n workflow transformation pipeline — converts Personas automation definitions into n8n JSON workflows via a streaming Claude CLI pass. Includes a prompt sanitiser, a streaming output parser, job-state machine, user-confirmation gate, and a CLI runner that drives the transformation end-to-end. Also manages n8n session persistence and rate-limit tracking.
contexts.name: n8n-integration

contexts.description: Hooks that orchestrate the n8n import wizard: useN8nWizard is the top-level orchestrator composing session, transform, and test sub-hooks. Handler hooks decompose wizard actions into lifecycle, transform, and generic event handlers. useWorkflowImport calls the backend transform IPC and useN8nDesignData fetches the resulting design object.
contexts.name: n8n-wizard-orchestration

contexts.description: State management for the n8n import wizard: four reducers (session, navigation, transform, test) each managing their own slice of wizard state, and the colorTokens module that maps n8n node types to brand-consistent colour tokens for parser result visualisation.
contexts.name: n8n-wizard-state

contexts.description: UI steps for the multi-step n8n workflow import wizard: the root import tab (step orchestrator), parser results display with grouped sections, session list, persona entity summary, selection checkbox, step indicator widget, and wizard footer navigation. Surfaces the parsed n8n workflow nodes as reviewable entity groups before transformation.
contexts.name: n8n-wizard-steps

contexts.description: Upload and ingestion step for the n8n import wizard: a drag-and-drop / file-picker upload panel, paste-from-clipboard import, URL import, platform origin labels, and a JSON preview card. Three distinct ingestion hooks (useFileUpload, usePasteImport, useUrlImport) normalise their respective input formats into the same n8n JSON payload.
contexts.name: n8n-wizard-upload

contexts.api_surface: ExposedResource CRUD (network/exposure); BundleImportPreview, NetworkAccessScope (network/bundle); EnclavePolicy, EnclaveVerifyResult (network/enclave)
contexts.description: Handles resource exposure management and cryptographically signed bundle exchange over the P2P network. Operators control which personas, templates, and connectors are exposed at which access level (ExposureManager), generate signed shareable bundle archives with enclave verification (BundleExportDialog), and import bundles from peers with conflict preview, provenance badge display, enclave tamper detection, and import success celebration (BundleImportDialog, BundlePreviewContent, EnclaveVerificationView). ShareLinkHandler resolves incoming share-link deep links.
contexts.name: network-bundle-sharing

contexts.api_surface: ConnectionHealth, MessagingMetrics, ConnectionMetricsSnapshot, ManifestSyncMetrics, DiscoveredPeer, PeerManifestEntry (network/discovery)
contexts.description: Renders the P2P network dashboard with live status (connected peers, latency, port, peer ID), messaging/connection/manifest-sync metrics panels, local identity display-name management, peer discovery list with expandable detail drawer, and access scope badges. Provides the NetworkIcons asset set used throughout the network settings surface. Reads discovery metrics and peer manifests from the network/discovery Rust command layer in real time.
contexts.name: network-peer-management

contexts.description: Slice tracking network connectivity status and P2P peer discovery. Monitors online/offline transitions and mDNS-discovered peers, surfacing connection quality indicators in the UI and gating features that require network access.
contexts.name: network-state

contexts.description: Natural-language trigger input: parses plain-English scheduling phrases into structured trigger configs (e.g. 'every Monday at 9am'). Includes the NlTriggerInput component, the parser library, and its unit tests.
contexts.name: nl-trigger-parser

contexts.description: Notification channel management in the connector tab: shows a list of configured delivery channels (email, Slack, webhook, etc.) with per-channel settings and health badges. Users can add new channels via AddChannelButton. DeliveryHealthBadge surfaces delivery success rates from execution events.
contexts.name: notification-channels

contexts.description: Controls how and when users receive alerts from the self-healing system: configures per-severity thresholds (critical/high/medium/low) for in-app toast notifications with live test-fire capability, toggles the weekly health digest email, and manages outbound webhook subscriptions to Slack, Discord, Teams, and generic JSON endpoints including CRUD and send-test. Persists notification preferences to app_settings and webhook subscription records to the notification_subscriptions table. Depends on the events notification-subscriptions API module.
contexts.name: notification-settings

contexts.api_surface: Tauri OAuth commands; external OAuth provider redirect URLs
contexts.description: Composable hooks for driving OAuth consent flows: a low-level polling hook with AbortController lifecycle and ref-based secret storage, a protocol-level wrapper that adds onComplete/onError callbacks, a consent-step hook, and a universal OAuth composable for any provider. Credentials are kept in refs rather than state to prevent DevTools and Sentry exposure.
contexts.name: oauth-flow-hooks

contexts.description: Google OAuth 2.0 flow and token refresh management for connector authentication. google_oauth handles the full authorization code flow, token exchange, and refresh; oauth_refresh_lock serializes concurrent refresh attempts to prevent token churn; pairing handles device pairing codes for cross-device authentication bootstrap.
contexts.name: oauth-token-management

contexts.description: Domain types for the full observability surface: `ObservabilityMetric` for aggregated operational metrics, `AuditLog` and `AuditIncident` for security and change audit trails, `SettingsAuditLog` for configuration change history, `LlmSpend` for per-execution cost attribution, `ToolUsage` and `ToolAudit` for tool call tracking, `PolicyEvent` for governance policy triggers, and `FrontendCrash` for renderer error capture.
contexts.name: observability-audit-models

contexts.description: Execution dashboard metrics, anomaly drilldown, heatmaps, healing issue tracking, prompt lab analytics, and digest generation. Aggregates execution data into time-series charts, reliability rollups, and provider usage stats for the main overview dashboard.
contexts.name: observability-metrics

contexts.description: Obsidian vault integration — reads and writes markdown notes, traverses the vault graph, lints markdown quality, resolves conflicts between Personas-managed notes and user edits, revitalises stale notes, and mirrors test data. Acts as a persistent knowledge-management backend backed by a local Obsidian vault.
contexts.name: obsidian-brain

contexts.description: Top-level page shell for the Obsidian Brain plugin, routing between six tab panels (Setup, Sync, Browse, Graph, Cloud, Revitalize). Lazy-loads each sub-panel for code splitting, and anchors per-tab test IDs for the guided onboarding tour's spotlight mechanism using a literal map to stay statically analyzable.
contexts.name: obsidian-brain-shell

contexts.description: Google Drive backup panel that mirrors the active Obsidian vault to the user's Drive account. Handles OAuth authorization flow, shows storage quota, and exposes push/pull sync actions with result reporting. Requires both a connected local vault and an authenticated Personas account.
contexts.name: obsidian-cloud-sync

contexts.api_surface: obsidian_graph_search, obsidian_graph_stats, obsidian_graph_list_orphans, obsidian_graph_list_mocs, obsidian_graph_append_daily_note, obsidian_graph_write_meeting_note, obsidian_graph_start/stop_watcher
contexts.description: Graph analytics and note-writing panel that surfaces vault health metrics (total notes, links, orphans, MOCs, daily notes), full-text search, and quick-capture forms for daily journal entries and meeting notes. Starts a real-time file-system watcher via IPC and debounces vault-changed events to auto-refresh stats.
contexts.name: obsidian-graph-intelligence

contexts.description: Utility for launching the Obsidian desktop app from within Personas via the `obsidian://open` URI scheme. Builds vault-relative note URIs from the vault name and note path, normalizing separators and stripping the `.md` extension so Obsidian resolves the correct note regardless of location within the vault.
contexts.name: obsidian-open-deep-link

contexts.description: AI-driven vault maintenance panel ('Revitalize') that runs a background job to prune stale notes, merge duplicates, and refresh vault structure using an LLM. Streams live output lines, shows a post-pass summary with token savings and highlights, and persists run history across app restarts.
contexts.name: obsidian-revitalize

contexts.description: Shared vault-roster hook and sidebar component for managing multiple saved Obsidian vault configurations. Configs are persisted in the app database (migrated from legacy localStorage on first access), broadcast cross-panel via a CustomEvent so all open panels stay in sync without a store subscription.
contexts.name: obsidian-saved-vault-configs

contexts.description: App-wide background hooks that run outside the plugin page. `useObsidianVaultRehydration` restores the active-vault Zustand state from the persisted config on app start so 'no vault connected' is never shown after a restart. `useVisibleConnectorDefinitions` gates the `obsidian_memory` connector entry in connector pickers until a vault is configured.
contexts.name: obsidian-session-services

contexts.description: Read-only vault file browser with a collapsible folder tree, in-app Markdown preview with YAML frontmatter property extraction, and a deep-link button to open any selected note directly in the Obsidian app. Implements ghost skeleton trees and note-body placeholders to avoid flash-of-loading on fast local reads.
contexts.name: obsidian-vault-browse

contexts.description: Vault connection and configuration panel: auto-detects or browses for Obsidian vault paths, tests connectivity, and saves the active vault config with sync options and folder mapping. Also controls the opt-in knowledge mirror (research lab, execution history, Athena) that continuously writes app data into the vault as Markdown notes.
contexts.name: obsidian-vault-setup

contexts.description: Bidirectional sync panel between the Personas app and the Obsidian vault. Lets the user select individual personas to push as Markdown notes, pull vault changes back into the app, and resolve conflicts with a three-way (keep-app / keep-vault / skip) decision UI backed by a persistent sync log.
contexts.name: obsidian-vault-sync

contexts.description: The blocking welcome modal that walks new users through 5 steps: appearance customization, desktop app discovery, template selection, agent adoption, and first execution. It is rendered by OnboardingOverlay, which reads onboardingActive from the system store and gates all navigation through useOnboardingState. The modal owns the screen while open — the guided tour panel is suppressed until the modal closes.
contexts.name: onboarding-modal-shell

contexts.api_surface: Calls listDesignReviews, getTrendingTemplates, discoverDesktopApps, getDesktopConnectorManifest, approveDesktopCapabilities
contexts.description: Custom hook (useOnboardingState) that drives all data loading and step transitions for the onboarding modal. It fetches trending templates with a zero-credential prioritization strategy, orchestrates desktop app discovery via Tauri IPC, handles adoption-wizard deduplication, and emits Sentry metrics for each phase. All step handlers (appearance → discover → pick-template → adopt → execute) live here, keeping OnboardingOverlay a pure rendering shell.
contexts.name: onboarding-state-orchestration

contexts.description: The four inline step content components rendered inside the onboarding modal: AppearanceStep (theme, language, density, brightness), DesktopDiscoveryStep (scanned app list with approve controls), TemplatePickerStep (top-3 curated template cards), and ExecutionStep (live first-run persona execution with Tauri event listener). Each step is a self-contained UI panel; navigation logic lives in useOnboardingState.
contexts.name: onboarding-steps

contexts.api_surface: Slack API (outbound), Discord API (outbound), generic webhooks (outbound)
contexts.description: Outbound event fan-out stack: routes persona_events to user-configured Slack/Discord/Teams/generic JSON webhooks via Mustache templates, relays selected events to the cloud synchronisation layer, polls Slack and Discord channels for inbound messages and injects them as events, and generates a scheduled performance digest delivered via OS notification plus messaging channels.
contexts.name: outbound-notifications

contexts.description: Parses the raw JSONL output stream from Claude CLI into typed protocol messages and stream line events. Handles tool use blocks, subagent fan-out attribution (P4), message chunking, safe JSON sanitization, and tool outcome classification. Forms the boundary between raw CLI bytes and typed execution events.
contexts.name: output-stream-parser

contexts.description: Aggregated execution activity dashboard: global execution list, per-persona LLM spend, error category breakdown, value rollup, and Athena usage. useExecutionMetrics and useLlmSpend pull from execution history to drive KPI cards and time-series charts. This is the primary 'what did my agents spend today?' surface.
contexts.name: overview-activity-metrics

contexts.description: Alert rules management, alert history, real-time anomaly drilldown, and Athena health tracking. The global alert evaluator runs as a background hook that continuously evaluates rules against live metrics and emits toast notifications on violations. AnomalyDrilldownPanel lets operators drill into detected statistical outliers.
contexts.name: overview-alert-anomaly

contexts.description: The Certification Command Center evaluates personas against standards using judge panels and eval runs. Surfaces certification status per team/persona, gate breakdowns, grounding tables, trajectory charts, and run history. useCertificationData drives deferred loading from the overviewStore certification slice.
contexts.name: overview-certification

contexts.description: Management UI for scheduled (cron) agents: shows next-run time, last-run status, and cron expression for each scheduled persona. cronHelpers parses cron expressions and computes humanized next-run labels.
contexts.name: overview-cron-agents

contexts.description: Hooks that power the execution dashboard pipeline on the Overview tab: aggregating execution metrics across all personas, building a pipeline-stage view of concurrent and historical runs, and feeding the dashboard with live counts and status breakdowns. Bridges the real-time event bus and the overview store.
contexts.name: overview-dashboard-hooks

contexts.description: The top-level Overview routing shell and dashboard home. OverviewPage lazy-loads each subtab on demand and mounts OverviewFilterContext for shared filter state. DashboardWithSubtabs hosts the home/analytics subtabs; widgets (DashboardChartCard, TopPerformersWidget, TrafficErrorsChart) are reusable dashboard card primitives.
contexts.name: overview-dashboard-shell

contexts.description: Slices powering the main dashboard view — the overview metrics panel, home-spine multi-window layout manager, and the memory/knowledge graph panel. The homeSpineWindows utility handles window ordering, resizing, and pinning state for the dashboard grid.
contexts.name: overview-dashboard-state

contexts.description: The Director coaching tab UI: a per-persona coaching table, persona detail modals, attention triage bar, momentum summary, stale-sweep action, value-leak visualization, and scope management. Consumes useDirector and exposes the full Director command surface to the operator.
contexts.name: overview-director-coaching

contexts.description: Core scoring engine for the Director meta-persona: computes attention scores, momentum, category rollups, and score distributions across the persona roster. directorScore derives numeric ratings; attention.ts maps categories to triage priority; useDirector is the single hook consumed by all Director surfaces.
contexts.name: overview-director-scoring

contexts.description: Prototype empty-state system for Overview tabs: IllustrationEmptyState renders a static illustration with CTA; MotionEmptyState wraps it in a Framer Motion entrance animation; motifs (ActivityMotif, KnowledgeMotif, MemoriesMotif) are SVG glyphs for themed empty states. Includes light/dark illustration asset pairs for approval, leaderboard, and messages tabs.
contexts.name: overview-empty-states

contexts.description: Displays the durable, SQLite-backed log of PersonaEvent rows so operators can search what happened. Uses the searchEvents API with filter inputs and supports saved filter views. Entry point is EventLogList; EventDetailModal drills into individual events with a JSON syntax-highlighted view.
contexts.name: overview-event-log

contexts.description: Slices for real-time event streams, system messages, alert management, and process activity tracking. The event slice subscribes to Tauri backend events; alertSlice manages triggered alert conditions; processActivity tracks concurrently running background operations.
contexts.name: overview-events-state

contexts.description: Heatmap and rotation overview analytics panels for visualizing execution density over time and agent rotation patterns. ExecutionHeatmap renders a calendar-style density grid; RotationOverviewPanel shows how frequently each persona runs across time slots. analyticsHelpers provides bucketing and normalization utilities.
contexts.name: overview-execution-analytics

contexts.description: Deep-dive modal for a single execution record. outputParser extracts structured sections from raw execution output; provenance.ts resolves the data lineage (which persona, template, chain); OutputSections renders each parsed section in a collapsible layout. Tests cover provenance edge cases.
contexts.name: overview-execution-detail

contexts.description: Visualizes the AI self-healing pipeline: surfaces healing timeline events, issue summaries, and live healing stream overlays so operators can see which failures the healer is addressing. Driven by HealingTimelineEvent bindings correlated by chain_id. The HealingToast in the feedback folder is co-owned here as it surfaces healing state to the top-level notification layer.
contexts.name: overview-healing-monitor

contexts.api_surface: Tauri commands: get_health_bundle, health_check_local, health_check_agents, list_healing_actions, apply_healing_action
contexts.description: IPC wrappers for the persona health dashboard: the health bundle command (a single server-side join of monthly spend, healing issues, BYOM policy, and provider usage), per-section system healthchecks (local, agents, cloud, circuit-breaker, subscriptions), and healing operations (listing, applying, and tracking automated issue remediation). Drives the Overview → Health tab.
contexts.name: overview-health-api

contexts.description: Per-persona health summary dashboard and public status page view. compositeHealthScore computes a weighted score from latency, error rate, and healing coverage; useStatusPageData drives the public-facing status view. Tests confirm score calculation accuracy.
contexts.name: overview-health-dashboard

contexts.description: Slices tracking agent health, autonomous healing workflows, quality certification scores, and cron-scheduled agent runs. The healing slice surfaces issue analysis and retry chains; personaHealth aggregates per-persona health scores; certification tracks passing/failing quality criteria.
contexts.name: overview-health-state

contexts.description: Deep-dive detail view for a single incident: a breakdown modal with timeline, affected spans, resolution state, and deep-link navigation. useIncidentsData drives data fetching; useIncidentActions handles resolve/dismiss/escalate mutations.
contexts.name: overview-incident-detail

contexts.api_surface: Tauri commands: list_audit_incidents, list_design_reviews, fetch_cert_status, list_memory_categories, list_saved_views
contexts.description: IPC wrappers for the cross-cutting Overview audit surfaces: audit incidents inbox (filterable cross-source incident log), manual and design review queues (human-in-the-loop review of persona outputs and build outputs), eval certification status (team streak and verdict distribution from doc/test/runs/), persona memories (categories, dispute claims), execution messages, overview events, and saved views (persisted filter/column presets). These form the human review and audit trail layer.
contexts.name: overview-incidents-api

contexts.description: The incidents inbox where operators triage system-level failures grouped by agent. Provides filtering, severity classification using incidentTaxonomy, column configuration, and a KPI header showing open/critical counts. Groups incidents by IncidentAgentGroup for a per-persona view of failure patterns.
contexts.name: overview-incidents-inbox

contexts.description: IPC wrappers for the Overview intelligence features: execution knowledge extraction (structured facts and knowledge graphs distilled from persona runs), smart template search (semantic search across the template library), and team synthesis from templates (AI composing a team topology from a natural-language query). These power the AI-assisted discovery surfaces in the Overview and template browser.
contexts.name: overview-intelligence-api

contexts.description: Knowledge graph dashboard that surfaces entries in the agent knowledge base with annotation support. KnowledgeGraphDashboard renders browseable knowledge rows; AnnotateModal lets operators tag/enrich entries; KnowledgeTypeIcons provides visual classification icons by knowledge category.
contexts.name: overview-knowledge

contexts.description: Ranks personas by composite performance score across multiple dimensions using a radar chart and matrix view. leaderboardScoring.ts computes per-dimension scores; leaderboardRanking.ts produces the final ordered list. Supports toggling between list and matrix layout views.
contexts.name: overview-leaderboard

contexts.description: Read-side memory browser: paginated memory cards with filter bar, dense/graph/list layout toggles, and a detail modal per memory. The graph view (MemoriesPageGraph) renders a force-directed node graph of memory relationships. All layout modes share the same useOverviewStore memories slice.
contexts.name: overview-memories-browser

contexts.description: Write-side memory management: create new memories, review and resolve conflicts between competing memory claims, and inspect claims per memory. memoryConflicts computes pairwise conflicts; conflictHelpers provides merge/reject resolution actions; memoryVisualTokens maps memory categories to colour tokens.
contexts.name: overview-memory-management

contexts.description: Inbox of messages sent by personas to the operator, with channel delivery info, priority classification, and a detail modal. PriorityChip and ChannelDeliveryPill are inline display primitives; feedbackInstruction provides templated feedback copy surfaced in message threads.
contexts.name: overview-messages

contexts.api_surface: Tauri commands: get_overview_bundle, get_alert_rules, get_sla_dashboard, llm_spend_dashboard
contexts.description: IPC wrappers for the Overview metrics and analytics surface: the observability bundle (alert rules, fired alerts, metrics charts, heatmaps, execution dashboard, anomaly drilldown, A/B prompt test results), SLA dashboard (daily SLA points, persona-level and global SLA stats, healing summaries), and LLM spend dashboard (headless scanner/evaluator/design costs tracked outside per-execution billing). Powers the main Overview analytics views.
contexts.name: overview-metrics-api

contexts.description: The Mission Control dashboard home aggregates fleet optimization suggestions, upcoming routine schedules, and recent vault credential changes into a command-center pane. FleetOptimizationCard runs fleetOptimizer logic to surface idle or underperforming persona recommendations.
contexts.name: overview-mission-control

contexts.description: Core observability dashboard showing system traces, IPC performance, and aggregated metrics charts. Consumes UnifiedSpan/SystemTrace data from the trace engine and renders span trees and operational dashboards. Serves the user question 'what is running and how fast?'
contexts.name: overview-observability-traces

contexts.description: Swipe-card and table-based backlog management for accumulated review items. BacklogFocusDeck provides a Tinder-style swipe UX; BacklogTable supports bulk triage; AthenaVerdictCard surfaces Athena's pre-scored recommendation for each item; BacklogDetailModal shows full context and ledger entries.
contexts.name: overview-review-backlog

contexts.description: Focused decision flow for reviewing one item at a time: a full-screen card with approve/reject actions, auto-resolved badge for items resolved by the healer before human action, and a review focus flow that drives a sequential session. Designed for operators who prefer a zero-distraction triage UX.
contexts.name: overview-review-focus

contexts.description: The manual review inbox where operators see and act on items that require human decision: flagged executions, knowledge approvals, and pending actions. ManualReviewList is the entry point; useManualReviewQueue drives pagination and filter state; reviewHelpers normalises raw queue items into display shape.
contexts.name: overview-review-inbox

contexts.description: Shared utilities and display primitives used across all Overview sub-modules. dashboardGrid defines responsive grid layout constants; metricIdentity provides stable metric IDs for chart key stability; fleetOptimizer heuristics power the mission control fleet card; computeTrends and formatRelativeShort are display helpers. KpiTile and TrendIndicator are micro-components used in KPI header rows.
contexts.name: overview-shared-libs

contexts.description: SLA compliance dashboard that displays per-persona SLA cards with success-rate targets, breach counts, and trend indicators. slaHelpers computes SLA grades from execution history; SLADashboard aggregates all active personas' SLA status in a grid.
contexts.name: overview-sla

contexts.description: Top-level Zustand store that composes the overview domain slices — dashboard metrics, messages, events, healing issues, memories, cron agents, alerts, persona health, certifications, process activity, and the home-spine window manager.
contexts.name: overview-store-root

contexts.description: The system-level health panel showing app crash logs, disk usage, configuration state, and install status. Composed of SectionCard sections; ConfigurationPopup and popupFieldConfigs drive the inline config editing UX; useHealthChecks polls platform health indicators from Tauri.
contexts.name: overview-system-health-panel

contexts.description: Time-series token and tool usage charts with period comparison and pivot by tool. LazyChart defers Recharts bundle loading; MetricChart is the reusable chart primitive; pivotToolUsage aggregates raw usage rows into per-tool series; periodComparison computes period-over-period deltas.
contexts.name: overview-usage-charts

contexts.description: The Vitals Ledger (renamed from Heartbeats) displays per-execution heartbeat rows with row-level detail, healing effectiveness, and insight panels for alerts, burn rate, and cascade failures. VitalsLedger is the main table; InsightBand surfaces contextual recommendations based on detected patterns.
contexts.name: overview-vitals-ledger

contexts.description: Remaining domain model types spanning three distinct concerns: P2P networking types gated behind the `p2p` feature (`Exposure`, `Identity`, `Signing`, `OwnedDevice` for device registry and P2P identity), developer tooling types (`DevIdea` with category vocabulary, `FrontendCrash` renderer error records, `SavedView` persisted UI filter presets), and `VirtualToolDefinition` / `VirtualToolId` for automation-backed virtual tool surfaces.
contexts.name: p2p-dev-misc-models

contexts.description: P2P identity and encrypted enclave for the Invisible Apps peer network. The identity module manages device keypairs, peer certificates, and trust anchors; the enclave module implements the encrypted data partition for persona secrets that travel over the QUIC transport. Both are compiled only when the p2p feature is enabled.
contexts.name: p2p-identity-enclave

contexts.name: persona-editor

contexts.name: persona-jobs

contexts.description: Card-level rendering for the persona overview table: row cells, column definitions, per-card actions (run, duplicate, delete), batch-action bar, health and status badges. These components compose the visual content of each persona row and the multi-select bulk-operation strip.

contexts.name: persona-overview-director

contexts.name: persona-overview-page

contexts.name: persona-portability

contexts.name: pipeline-triggers-state

contexts.description: Cross-feature integration surface that lets personas own a set of linked recipes. LinkedRecipesSection fetches, displays, links, and unlinks recipes for a given personaId via pipelineStore, and embeds the RecipePicker and RecipePlaygroundModal so linked recipes can be run directly from the persona detail view.
contexts.name: recipe-persona-linking

contexts.description: Interactive playground modal for testing recipes end-to-end. RecipePlaygroundModal hosts a four-tab shell (Overview, Test Runner, History, Versions). useRecipeTestRunner manages a two-phase execution: prompt rendering via the backend API, then LLM execution via the CLI stream, with run-id correlation to prevent cross-run output contamination. RecipeInputSection handles schema-driven or free-form input entry and mock-value management; RecipeOutputSection renders streaming terminal output and final results.
contexts.name: recipe-playground

contexts.description: Shared visual primitives and parsing utilities used across all recipe sub-features. Includes three decorative illustrations (RecipeBookIllustration, PuzzlePieceIllustration, VersionTimelineIllustration), the animated RecipePageFlipLoader, a SchemaParseErrorBanner for inline JSON parse errors, and recipeParseUtils with typed helpers for tags, input-schema, and mock-value JSON.
contexts.name: recipe-shared

contexts.description: AI-assisted prompt-template versioning inside the playground. RecipeVersionsTab streams an LLM-generated diff proposal (via useRecipeVersioning hook), presents a live terminal strip and diff preview, then lets the user accept (with optimistic-lock protection against concurrent edits) or revert to a prior version. Maintains a timeline of all committed versions.
contexts.name: recipe-versioning

contexts.description: Repository for persona recipes — reusable prompt templates with parameterized input schemas that can be instantiated into persona configurations. Includes recipe definitions, recipe suggestions generated by the AI, and credential recipe associations that bundle connector requirements.
contexts.name: recipes-repo

contexts.api_surface: Tauri commands: remote_command_list_pending, remote_command_approve, remote_command_reject; Supabase table: pending_commands (GET, PATCH via SyncClient)
contexts.description: Implements the approval-gated remote run request flow: the web dashboard inserts a `pending_commands` row targeting a specific device, this module polls Supabase every 15 seconds for rows addressed to this device, and surfaces each as a `remote-command-pending` Tauri event. The user must explicitly approve or reject via `remote_command_approve` / `remote_command_reject` Tauri commands — approved runs execute locally via `execute_persona_inner` with the result written back to the Supabase row. Stale requests older than one hour are auto-expired; command IDs are validated as UUIDs before PostgREST interpolation to prevent query-injection attacks.
contexts.name: remote-command-approval

contexts.description: Intermediate representation compiler for the Media Studio that translates a user-authored Composition into a flat, pre-resolved RenderPlan consumable by both the browser preview and FFmpeg export renderers. The compiler is pure (no I/O); invariant checker validates I1–I11 properties in debug builds; the test module covers the golden example and all negative invariant paths.
contexts.name: render-plan-ir

contexts.description: Cross-cutting repository utilities: shared test fixture helpers (`test_fixtures.rs`), common row-mapping utilities (`utils.rs`), system operations (`system_ops.rs`), and the top-level `repos/mod.rs` registry that re-exports all repository modules. These support all repository layers without being domain-specific.
contexts.name: repos-shared-utilities

contexts.description: Pipeline/process-flow overview dashboard that shows all research projects grouped by their current phase (scoping → literature_review → hypothesis → experiment → analysis → writing → review → complete). It renders a schematic-style phase station rail with project chips, a domain-distribution bar, and summary counters. Reads from systemStore researchProjects and researchDashboardStats.
contexts.name: research-lab-dashboard

contexts.description: Experiment design, execution tracking, and run-results drawer for research projects. Experiments link to hypotheses and carry an ExperimentConfig (linkedPersonaId, inputDataTemplate, passPattern) stored as JSON in the DB. The ExperimentRunsDrawer shows per-run results with pass/fail evaluation against the pattern or terminal execution status.
contexts.name: research-lab-experiments

contexts.description: Research finding capture and display. A form allows attaching findings to sources, experiments, and hypotheses via JSON id-lists; a panel lists all findings with confidence scores, category badges, and link counts. Findings are the primary evidence objects that flow into report synthesis.
contexts.name: research-lab-findings

contexts.description: Interactive knowledge-graph visualization of a research project's entities (project root, sources, hypotheses, experiments, findings, reports) laid out in columns with directional edges. Uses @xyflow/react for the canvas; graphLayout.ts computes node positions and edges; ResearchNode renders each entity as a typed, color-coded card.
contexts.name: research-lab-graph

contexts.description: Hypothesis lifecycle management including creation forms, a panel listing all hypotheses with confidence scores and status badges, and an AI-generation modal that submits a prompt to a linked persona and parses the structured output. The parseHypotheses utility tolerates numbered lists, bullets, JSON arrays, and plain text from LLM output.
contexts.name: research-lab-hypotheses

contexts.description: Literature source management with external search integration. Provides three panel variants (base, Atelier, Workbench), an arXiv Atom-feed search client, a Crossref REST client, and an ArxivSearchModal for discovering and adding papers. Users can add sources manually or via search and trigger ingestion (status flip: pending → ingesting → indexed).
contexts.name: research-lab-literature

contexts.description: Research project CRUD surface: list views in two visual styles (Cartograph card grid and Atelier compact list) plus a creation/edit form. Users create projects with a name, domain, thesis, description, and status; the list views allow selection which drives the active project context in systemStore.
contexts.name: research-lab-projects

contexts.description: AI-powered research report generation and preview. A synthesis prompt builder serialises project hypotheses, experiments, and findings into a structured prompt; a persona runs it and the output is parsed tolerantly (JSON object or markdown headings) into abstract + discussion sections. ReportPreviewDrawer renders the compiled markdown report with a download-file action.
contexts.name: research-lab-reports

contexts.description: Business-logic utilities and domain constants shared across all research-lab sub-features. tokens.ts defines the ProjectStatus, Domain, SourceType, and SourceStatus enums plus colour-badge helpers and i18n-label resolvers. experimentConfig.ts handles JSON serialisation/deserialisation and pass-pattern evaluation for experiment run configs. runPersona.ts bridges to the execution API to run a persona against a prompt; downloadFile.ts provides a browser download helper; useIngestSource.ts orchestrates the source status-flip workflow.
contexts.name: research-lab-shared-lib

contexts.description: Reusable UI primitives scoped to the Research Lab: a modal wrapper (ResearchLabFormModal), a signal-strength meter (SignalMeter), a shared FormField, a section header, a prototype tabs component, an empty-state block, and a PrototypeTabs layout. These components provide visual consistency across all research-lab sub-panels without re-using project-level shared components where research-specific styling is needed.
contexts.name: research-lab-shared-primitives

contexts.description: The top-level page component and tab-routing entry point for the Research Lab plugin. It lazy-loads each panel tab (dashboard, projects, literature, hypotheses, experiments, findings, reports, graph) behind Suspense boundaries and drives tab selection from Zustand systemStore. Depends on the i18n system and shared ContentLayout primitives.
contexts.name: research-lab-shell

contexts.api_surface: Tauri commands: list_research_projects, create_research_project, connect_obsidian_vault, list_obsidian_notes, sync_obsidian, resolve_conflict
contexts.description: IPC wrappers for the Research Lab plugin (projects, sessions, findings, citations, team binding, Obsidian vault path) and the Obsidian Brain plugin (vault detection and connection, note CRUD, sync with conflict resolution, doctrine ingest, search and retrieval). Research Lab manages structured research projects; Obsidian Brain mirrors them to a local vault for long-term knowledge persistence.
contexts.name: research-obsidian-api

contexts.description: Research and idea-scanning infrastructure — headless Claude passes that scrape external sources, run Qwen vision analysis, scan the codebase for latent improvement ideas, and synthesise research findings. Backs the Research Lab plugin and the idea pipeline that feeds the Dev Tools backlog.
contexts.name: research-tools

contexts.description: LLM spend tracking, tier usage enforcement, and memory ledger health. Monitors per-persona and per-session token costs, enforces subscription-tier limits, and audits the health of the companion brain's memory store. Feeds the billing and tier dashboards.
contexts.name: resource-tracking
